newsitem.title: ROMANIA: TENNIS-NASTASE AND TIRIAC GIVEN KEY FEDERATION POSTS.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-NASTASE AND TIRIAC GIVEN KEY FEDERATION POSTS.

text.p: Ilie Nastase and Ion Tiriac, Romania's top two tennis players in the 1970s, have been given key posts in the country's tennis federation.
"Romanian tennis wants Nastase and Tiriac as its main decision men...to help rebuild a powerful set-up in our country," federation general secretary Lucian Vasiliu said on Monday.
Nastase has been chosen as the federation's executive president, while Tiriac was elected as honorary president for life.
